prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right agency depends on what you need (SEO, PPC, social, branding, B2B demand gen, industry expertise), your budget, and the results you expect. I can help you find the best fit. A few quick next steps and tips:

Questions so I can narrow it down
- What type of marketing do you need (SEO, paid ads, social, email, branding, PR, full-service)?
- Are you B2B, B2C, nonprofit, or government?
- What’s your approximate monthly or annual budget?
- Do you want a local agency (e.g., Baltimore, Annapolis, Rockville) or is remote OK?
- What are your top goals (traffic, leads, sales, brand awareness)?

How to identify the “best” agency for your needs
- Define success metrics up front (CPL, MQLs, revenue, traffic).
- Look for proven case studies and client references in your industry.
- Check independent ratings and reviews (Clutch, UpCity, Google, LinkedIn).
- Verify relevant experience (platforms, ad spend ranges, technical SEO, regulatory experience).
- Ask about reporting cadence, KPIs, tools they use, and who will do the work (team vs. account exec).
- Request a proposal and a 30/60/90-day plan with expected outcomes and costs.
- Ask for client references you can call.

Where to search for vetted firms
- Clutch.co and UpCity (filter by location + service)
- Google Maps + Yelp (look at recent reviews)
- Baltimore Business Journal / local business awards
- Maryland chapter of the American Marketing Association or local networking groups
- LinkedIn searches for agencies in Maryland

Sample questions to ask agencies in interviews
- Can you share 2–3 case studies with measurable outcomes for similar clients?
- Who will be working on our account and what are their backgrounds?
- What’s your typical contract length and cancellation policy?
- How do you measure ROI and how often do you report?
- What is the expected timeline to see results?

If you want, tell me your goals, budget, industry, and whether you need local presence — I’ll shortlist 4–6 Maryland agencies that fit and suggest specific questions to ask each.
